# QC19: 四宜书屋 (绮春) Siyi Shuwu (Qichun)

Wave 4 · Qichun Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=QC19` · Page: `/scenes/#QC19` · Row: `research/buildings/QC19-siyi-shuwu-qichun/`

## What it was

四宜书屋 Siyi Shuwu of Qichun Yuan (not the Yuanming Yuan scene of the same name), built 1805 west of 生冬室 across the long river, in the 绮春园三十景 (S223; E0448, E0590, E0760). A gate of three bays and two halls of five (palace_r7_halls). In 1822 the dividing wall of the dowager's garden ran along its west and north walls (E0426); in 1855 a stone wall and corner gate were added for Daoguang's widows (E0625). A Yangshi Lei survey plan of 1850 exists (E0766); a survey of 2009 on the north bank of 湛清轩 found rubble to 0.6 m over Qing layers to 1.6 m (E0767, E0768).

From the inventory row: **built** 嘉庆十年七月 1805; **destroyed** 1860 (S06, S42, S01, S220, S361).

## The scene itself

### The leaf of 1744, its poem and preface

In Jiaqing's 绮春园三十景 (S223 卷十八; E0448), with a poem of 1805 (E0760).
